title: Benedict Gross and Epstein proposal for evolutionary dynamics at Harvard

tellings.quote: and Harvard references an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein.

plain: In the 2000s, Harvard University is said to have funded work on evolutionary dynamics, linked to the scientist Martin Nowak, that grew out of a proposal by the Harvard mathematician Benedict Gross and the financier Jeffrey Epstein. The mathematician Eric Weinstein points to a Harvard document that, he says, refers to "an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein." If true, it would show Epstein had a direct hand in shaping research at Harvard.
